description.value: Camy's Pizza has been a BC institution since 1985, self-described as the originator of butter chicken and tandoori chicken pizza in Canada. Now running four franchise locations across Surrey, Vancouver, Langley, and Maple Ridge, the menu spans gourmet pizzas made to order with fresh ingredients alongside Greek and Indian specialties, handcrafted pastas, calzones, wings, and salads. A touring cyclist stopping here would find a reliably familiar fast-food pizza experience with strong local roots.

Takeout is confirmed via prominent 'ORDER NOW' buttons and phone numbers for all four locations.
